title: A genipin-crosslinked chitosan hydrogel as a quasi-solid-state electrolyte for sustainable electrochemical capacitors
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00223K, Paper
Krzysztof Nowacki, Maciej Galiński
A genipin-crosslinked chitosan hydrogel electrolyte demonstrated excellent cycling stability; this alternative to glutaraldehyde highlights the potential of sustainable QSSEs in electrochemistry.
